The '''Fromiria system''' was located in the [[Mortex sector/Legends|Mortex sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the [[Fromirian roast queg]] [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish]].<ref name="CRO">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Fromirian roast queg]]|system=Fromiria [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Fromiria [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square R-5.<ref name="TEA" />
